description: Analyse a conversion A/B (or A/B/n) test the way a statistician would, instead of eyeballing two percentages. Two variants: difference and relative lift with confidence intervals, the right test (two-proportion z, or Fisher's exact when counts are low), p-value, significance and winner, plus the Bayesian probability that the variant beats control (Beta(1,1) priors). More than two: an omnibus chi-square and every variant against control with Holm or Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Always checks sample ratio mismatch (SRM) against the planned split — a broken split invalidates the result, however good it looks.
name: abtest_analyze
